label: postdoc
definition: Holds a PhD but works inside another PI's group with no independent group of their own
typical_evidence: Group page lists them under a PI; no own group page; no own funding

label: doctoral_student
definition: Enrolled PhD student or predoctoral researcher
typical_evidence: Listed on a PhD students page; thesis in progress

label: emeritus
definition: Retired or emeritus with no currently supervised group
typical_evidence: Faculty page marked emeritus; no PhD students listed since 2021

label: honorary_visiting
definition: Honorary/visiting/adjunct/affiliated title only with no substantive local appointment
typical_evidence: Title contains Honorary/Visiting/Adjunct/Affiliated and primary employer is elsewhere

label: teaching_track
definition: Teaching-focused position without PhD supervision rights
typical_evidence: Title such as Teaching Fellow/Lektor (teaching)/Senior Teaching Associate

label: corporate_only
definition: Sole affiliation is a for-profit lab

label: out_of_geography
definition: Primary appointment outside EU + EFTA + UK
typical_evidence: Institution country code not in scope list

label: relocated
definition: Held a qualifying post in scope but left before the 2026-08-01 snapshot date
typical_evidence: New institution announcement; old page removed

label: deceased
definition: Confirmed deceased before the snapshot date

label: no_qualifying_publication
definition: No first- middle- or last-author paper at a core-layer venue within the activity window

label: field_out_of_scope
definition: Research area is not core AI and not in the extended layer
typical_evidence: Publication record dominated by non-AI venues

label: duplicate
definition: Same physical person already present under another person_id

label: unverifiable
definition: Could not establish current position from any citable source
typical_evidence: Dead links; no faculty listing; no institutional page

label: contract_research
definition: Leads applied/contract research without doctoral supervision
typical_evidence: Fraunhofer/TNO/applied-institute group with no university appointment

label: non_independent
definition: Senior researcher or staff scientist embedded in another PI's group
typical_evidence: Listed under a department head; no own group

label: below_fte_threshold
definition: Appointment below 0.2 FTE at the location in question
typical_evidence: Endowed part-time chair (e.g. NL bijzonder hoogleraar) at nominal FTE

label: industry_primary_academic_courtesy
definition: Primary employer is a corporate lab with a courtesy academic title
typical_evidence: Company staff page plus honorary university title
